acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two yellow, elongated pixel clusters are attached to the right dorsal-lateral surface of the caudal peduncle. The distal margin of the upper caudal lobe exhibits a small, irregular notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A distribution of high-luminance circular spots is present on the posterior trunk and caudal peduncle. Pronounced light-refractive caustic patterns are visible across the surface of the upper caudal lobe.
